4 اخمر : see 1 in the former half of the paragraph, in six places. ―
-b2- أَخْمَرَتِ الأَرْضُ The land abounded with خَمَر, (S, K,) meaning tangled trees. (TA.) ＝
-A2- See also 1, latter part, in two places. ＝
-A3- اخمرهُ الشَّىْءَ He gave him the thing, or put him in possession of it, (K,) is a phrase common in El-Yemen: (Mohammad Ibn-Ketheer, TA:) a man says, أَخْمِرنِى كَذَا, meaning Give thou me such a thing as a free gift: put me in possession of it: and the like. (Mohammad Ibn-Ketheer, S.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
